mapper.select: select cscene_instance_id as sceneId , cscene_instance_name as sceneName from mp_flow_actuator group by cscene_instance_id, cscene_instance_name ;
select `type` as `name` , count(1) as `count` from mp_flow_actuator group by `type`;
select `actuator_type` as name , count(1) as `count` from mp_flow_task_task group by actuator_type;

select ifnull(sum(tx_bps),0) as totalRate from mp_flow_task_record where (task_id,pk) in (select task_id,max(pk) from mp_flow_task_record where create_time >= #{startTime} and create_time <= #{endTime} group by task_id );
